summary: Confirmed both specified within-group essay-similarity estimates against the required September 2026 PDF. Read an in-memory markdown conversion of all 103 pages, including Appendices A-D, and checked cited pages with PyMuPDF get_text and Table 5 with find_tables. Table 5 Panel B (PDF p. 41) supports all recorded control means, ITT and TOT coefficients, robust standard errors, and analysis-specific control and total counts. Unprinted treatment counts and arm statistics correctly remain null. The requested coding fields are supported: participant-level embedding similarity, higher values meaning more similar, across_people with AI available in Session One, and delayed after_ai without AI in Session Two. Both comparisons correctly use ai_vs_active because the original control could use standard online resources (PDF pp. 9 and 53); follow-up preserves that randomized comparison. No additional in-scope outcome or contrast was found under extraction rules 4-6. Figures 6 and A7 repeat the same similarity contrasts graphically, and the other outcomes are outside the paper-specific scope.
